invariants.text: Employee.id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
An employee's email must be a valid email address format.
An employee's age must be between 18 and 70, inclusive.
An employee's salary must be a positive number.
When creating a new employee, the system must validate that the email is valid, the age is between 18 and 70, and the salary is positive before saving the record to the database.
When updating an employee's age, the new age must still be between 18 and 70, inclusive.
When updating an employee's salary, the new salary must still be positive.
When updating an employee's email, the new email must be a valid email address format.
The total number of employees in the database must not exceed the maximum allowed by the application's design, if such a limit is enforced.
The sum of all employees' salaries must be greater than zero if there are any employees in the database.
An employee's age and salary cannot be modified to violate the constraints of being between 18 and 70 for age and positive for salary.
